title: The only wellness app that I use consistently
body:
I give it 5 out of 5. I’m a bit disappointed that they removed the list of randomly selected exercises from the home page and left only goals, it was fun doing the offered exercises from time to time.

But overall I love this app, I was using it over a year and it’s a part of my daily self-care routine.
